messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating phased router shift for service-router -> v2.4.1 at 2026-03-21T23:00Z. Wave plan: wave-size=15% every 3m for first 4 waves, then 10% until 100%. Hold conditions: any p99 spike > 250ms for 2 consecutive probes OR global error_rate > 3% for 1m. Notifying #eng-releases and oncall. @Jared M @Priya S
Jared M: Oncall here. I'll monitor p50/p95/p99, alloc pressure, and queue depth. Have rollback shortcut ready.
Priya S: Confirmed image rwd-router:v2.4.1-20260321 pinned in routing config. Release notes: https://redwood/release/271. Key change: header normalization fix + small perf tweak.
Nina K: Requesting session-drain policy: soft-drain at 60% green, preserve sticky cookies for 2m, then expire. That should avoid 401s for active sessions.
Jared M: Agreed. Also enable extra logging level=info for 10m in green to catch header edge cases.
deploy-bot: Preflight results:
```
k8s nodes: ready
smoke tests: ok
canary perf: ok (no regressions)
quota: ok
route pin: verified
```
Ops Bot: Capacity check: green pool spare capacity=25% across zones, autoscale margin=15%. No limits.
Priya S: Canary snippet for rollback (keep handy):
`./opsctl shift --to blue --percent 100 --reason "auto-rollback"`
Jared M: Starting wave 1 -> green=15% at 23:00. Watching metrics.
Ops Bot: Metrics update (23:01): p50=45ms p95=120ms p99=210ms err=0.4%
Jared M: Wave 2 -> green=30% at 23:03. Slight noise on p99 but within threshold.
Nina K: Observability flash: a small set of requests with cookie malformed leading to 400s in eu-west-2. Rate ~0.2%.
Priya S: Noted. Not a rollback trigger alone. Triage in parallel.
deploy-bot: Wave 4 -> green=60% at 23:09. current_weights: blue=40 green=60
Jared M: Seeing p99 tail jump to 260ms at 23:10 for ~90s correlated with eu-west-2 cohort. That's above p99 trigger. Recommend regional pause + targeted rollback for eu-west-2.
Priya S: Approve rollback in eu-west-2. Execute regional revert: green(eu-west-2)=0 -> blue=100. Keep other zones at green=60.
deploy-bot: Regional rollback executed. Global green now 45% (us-west/us-east unaffected). Action: mark release stage PARTIAL with regional rollback.
Nina K: Triage shows header normalization fix missed a case for cookie values with extra semicolons. Patch branch created hotfix/cookie-strip-20260321.
Jared M: Hold global progression for 30m while hotfix is validated in canary (20% global). If canary pass, resume waves.
deploy-bot: Noted. Posting follow-up in #eng-runtime after canary. If hotfix validated, plan: canary 20% -> +10% every 2m.
Priya S: Adding note to release notes: PARTIAL_ROLLOUT + regional rollback eu-west-2; follow-up hotfix branch link: https://git.redwood/hotfix/cookie-strip-20260321
Ops Bot: Reminder: rollback command available in ops dashboard and CLI. Escalation path: oncall -> infra lead -> eng-runtime.
Jared M: Leaving alerts on; will manually abort if we see new global regressions. Thanks team.
deploy-bot: Closing thread for coordination. Ongoing monitoring in dashboards and follow-ups in #eng-runtime. /end
